scope: Guarded publication through quiet slot receipts, caller-owned temporary requests, exact-event late acknowledgement ownership, pre-dispatch counter and occupied-slot persistence. JVM fixtures and JSON round trip; no real-room UI, real relay, delegated box, actual Android restart or physical-device acceptance claim.
guarded_cases: ordinary queue removal in flight cannot consume a new guarded owner
cancellation before dispatch leaves no replayable request
restart retains spent counters but cannot replay a guarded recording event
a denied guard cannot retain or publish anything
restart after an unknown offer preserves the occupied slot
a late receipt completes the current retry of the same exact event
failed counter persistence prevents an offer and leaves retry authority with the caller
an unknown offer never sends a replacement wrap in the same slot after timeout
rekey rejects waiting owners and invalidates captured generations
guarded receipt waits for delivery and never joins the restart or box queue
timeout before dispatch removes only the temporary request
ownership withdrawn before a slot rejects the request and only posts filler
the underlying dispatch rechecks ownership after slot selection
rekey after an unknown offer cannot occupy the same slot again
